luiskr.com / core/utils/media / encodeMediaUrl

function encodeMediaUrl(url): string

Defined in: core/utils/media.ts:112

Percent-encodes a media URL for attribute/markup emission — bucket keys can carry literal spaces ('brazilian leather/…', '…PARIS FASHION-WEEK…') and non-ASCII ('garçonne'), which the bucket serves fine but which break candidates (its grammar splits on whitespace) and RFC-3986-strict contexts (sitemap locs, JSON-LD image/contentUrl). Idempotent: already-encoded input decodes first, so a %20 never becomes %2520 (encodeURI escapes '%' itself). Malformed escapes make decodeURI throw — the catch emits the input with bare '%' → %25.

Parameters

url

string

Raw or encoded media URL (may contain spaces/non-ASCII).

Returns

string

The emission-safe URL ('' stays '').
